title: A page of an export
description: What GET /v1/exports/{name} answers: the events after the export's cursor, in every log the caller may read.

events.description: Oldest first within each log; each event's source names its log, and its sequence its place there.

next.description: What POST /v1/exports/{name} takes, as {"next": …}, to move the cursor past these events.

gaps.description: Each log trimmed past the cursor, which was read from its oldest event.

after.description: The sequence the cursor was at.

oldest.description: The oldest sequence the log still held.
